contract_plain_english: If X has the standard normal distribution, then for every nonnegative real threshold t, the probability that the magnitude of X is at least t is at most 2 exp(−t²/2). This is a closed, two-sided Gaussian tail bound, derived in the source from a one-sided normal-tail estimate and symmetry.
